content: cmdk 1.1.1 (npm-verified) current; supports React 19 via peer range but hard-depends on @radix-ui/react-dialog ^1.1.6, @radix-ui/react-id, @radix-ui/react-primitive, @radix-ui/react-compose-refs — installing it drags the Radix overlay/focus stack into a Base UI-only app (two dialog systems, duplicate a11y layers, ~+15kB). shadcn/ui 'base' command variant is still cmdk-backed, NOT Base UI primitives (ui.shadcn.com verified).
